name: Amesergide
summary: Amesergide is a serotonin receptor antagonist of the ergoline and lysergamide families related to methysergide which was under development by Eli Lilly and Company for the treatment of a variety of conditions including depression, anxiety, schizophrenia, male sexual dysfunction, migraine, and thrombosis but was never marketed.

pharmacology.text: Amesergide acts as a selective antagonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2C receptors (Ki = 1.96–15.1 nM). It is also an antagonist of the serotonin 5-HT7 receptor with relatively lower affinity (Ki = 78.0 nM). The drug is a potent antagonist of the α2-adrenergic receptor in addition to the 5-HT2 receptors via its major active metabolite 4-hydroxyamesergide (Ki = 13 nM).
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor antagonist; Serotonin 5-HT2 receptor antagonist

uses.text: Amesergide (INN, USAN; developmental code name LY-237733) is a serotonin receptor antagonist of the ergoline and lysergamide families related to methysergide which was under development by Eli Lilly and Company for the treatment of a variety of conditions including depression, anxiety, schizophrenia, male sexual dysfunction, migraine, and thrombosis but was never marketed.

summaryZh: 安麥角是一種血清素受體拮抗劑，屬於麥角靈和麥角醯胺家族，與美西麥角相關。蓋藥物由禮來公司開發，用於治療多種疾病，包括抑鬱症、焦慮症、精神分裂症、男性性功能障礙、偏頭痛和血栓形成，但從未上市。在停止開發之前，它已進入治療抑鬱症、勃起功能障礙和早泄的II期臨床試驗。
